"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/check-if-strings-can-be-made-equal-with-operations-i/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

2839. Check if Strings Can be Made Equal With Operations I

You are given two strings s1 and s2, both of length 4, consisting of lowercase English letters.

You can apply the following operation on any of the two strings any number of times:

- Choose any two indices i and j such that j - i = 2, then swap the two characters at those indices in the string.

Return true if you can make the strings s1 and s2 equal, and false otherwise.

Example 1:

Input: s1 = "abcd", s2 = "cdab"
Output: true
Explanation: We can do the following operations on s1:
- Choose the indices i = 0, j = 2. The resulting string is s1 = "cbad".
- Choose the indices i = 1, j = 3. The resulting string is s1 = "cdab" = s2.

Example 2:

Input: s1 = "abcd", s2 = "dacb"
Output: false
Explanation: It is not possible to make the two strings equal.

Constraints:

    s1.length == s2.length == 4
    s1 and s2 consist only of lowercase English letters.
"""


class Solution:
    def canBeEqual(self, s1: str, s2: str) -> bool:
        # Since we can only swap characters at indices with difference 2,
        # characters at even indices can only be swapped among even indices,
        # and characters at odd indices can only be swapped among odd indices.
        # So the multiset of characters at even indices in s1 must match that in s2,
        # and similarly for odd indices.
        even_s1 = [s1[i] for i in range(0, 4, 2)]
        even_s2 = [s2[i] for i in range(0, 4, 2)]
        odd_s1 = [s1[i] for i in range(1, 4, 2)]
        odd_s2 = [s2[i] for i in range(1, 4, 2)]
        return sorted(even_s1) == sorted(even_s2) and sorted(odd_s1) == sorted(odd_s2)


sol = Solution()

print(sol.canBeEqual("abcd", "cdab"))  # True

assert sol.canBeEqual("abcd", "cdab") == True
assert sol.canBeEqual("abcd", "dacb") == False

assert sol.canBeEqual("aaaa", "aaaa") == True
assert sol.canBeEqual("abab", "baba") == False
assert sol.canBeEqual("aabb", "bbaa") == True
assert sol.canBeEqual("zzzz", "zzzz") == True
assert sol.canBeEqual("abcd", "abdc") == False
assert sol.canBeEqual("abcd", "badc") == False
assert sol.canBeEqual("aabc", "abca") == False
assert sol.canBeEqual("dcba", "abcd") == False
assert sol.canBeEqual("aabb", "abab") == False
assert sol.canBeEqual("xyzw", "wzyx") == False
assert sol.canBeEqual("mnop", "ponm") == False
assert sol.canBeEqual("aabb", "baba") == False
